featured_reviews.name: Kloseven Royale
featured_reviews.review_text:
I, being a classroom student for 2 years of FIITJEE, am really grateful to the institute for my outstanding result in JEE Adv. The institute not only focused on our academic development, but rather the critical thinking abilities one needs for the final exam. The classrooms are well equipped and study material given follows a step by step approach to tackle a question.
The teachers of FIITJEE have been fully supporting my endeavour like Udit Sir for Physics, Vineet Sir for Maths and Sachin Sir for Chemistry. They are highly qualified and were open to mentor whenever I needed direction. I wholeheartedly owe my success to FIITJEE Andheri.
